Rho 0.4.0-dev.38 improves model setup, Agent workflows, editor stability, and cross-platform release verification.

## Highlights

- Provider-first Model settings now discover model catalogs, expose reviewed capabilities, support capability-based routing, and offer one-confirmation Provider removal.
- Agent work is organized into durable project-scoped Conversations with bounded concurrency, retry, cancellation, and per-file Apply/Undo safety.
- Editor, Console, Environment, Data Viewer, References, Rename, and project-watcher refresh paths preserve focus, viewport, selection, and truthful error state more reliably.
- Rho now ships under AGPL-3.0-only, bundles its license and notices, documents privacy/security/signing policy, and performs update checks only after an explicit user action.

## Windows trust notice

- The Windows installer is Authenticode-signed with a SignPath Free Trial self-signed test certificate. It is not publicly trusted, does not establish SignPath Foundation acceptance or a production publisher, and Windows or SmartScreen may still warn.
- Verify the installer against the SHA-256 published with this release. The macOS package remains independently Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled.

## Verification

- Candidate evidence binds the exact source commit, final post-sign Windows bytes, SignPath request and certificate facts, macOS notarization/stapling, platform checksums, and the reviewed release body.
- Publication remains gated by exact installed Windows and macOS acceptance plus an explicit MAC5 GO for the same immutable artifacts.
